name: Allama
meaning_en: Name of the Veerashaiva mystic Allama Prabhu.

name: Annamayya
meaning_en: Telugu form honouring the saint-poet Annamacharya; 'Anna' as father/elder with devotional suffix.

name: Bhimashankar
meaning_en: Shiva as the mighty, auspicious lord.

name: Pampa
meaning_en: Adi-kavi of Kannada; name of the Tungabhadra river and its deity.

name: Potana
meaning_en: Name of Bammera Potana, Telugu poet who rendered the Bhagavatam.

name: Pullaiah
meaning_en: Telugu respectful name, from Pulla (flower/lotus) with ayya.

name: Subbarao
meaning_en: Subramanya the chief; Telugu family name form.

name: Tikkana
meaning_en: Telugu poet who composed the later books of the Mahabharata.

name: Venkat
meaning_en: Short form of Venkateshwara; the lord of the Venkata hill.

name: Venkateshwarlu
meaning_en: Telugu form of Venkateshwara, lord of Venkata hill.
